evidence.observation: Pressure stable near 3.07-3.10 Torr through ramp and early growth
Pressure rising steadily 3.095->3.151->3.21->3.266 Torr with Ar flow constant at ~100 sccm
Exhaust O2 rising 8.4->17.1->22.9->30.8 ppm alongside the pressure rise; air is getting into a tube held below atmospheric pressure
MFC reads ~100 sccm, on setpoint, so a stuck MFC is ruled out
Thermocouple steady at 750 C with normal heater power

args.missing_evidence: A leak-up (rate-of-rise) test with gas flow stopped, or a helium leak check at the flanges, would confirm the seal leak. An exhaust blockage would raise pressure without raising O2. No reference ranges were provided to compare against.
